name: @ag-ui/cloudflare-agents-examples
description: Cloudflare Agents (Durable Object) Worker serving the AG-UI Dojo demos through @ag-ui/cloudflare-agents. Runs locally under wrangler dev (workerd), no Cloudflare account needed. Standalone install (own lockfile) so wrangler/workerd stay out of the root workspace; the AG-UI packages are linked from this repo and must be built first.
